form.label: 👽️ Le Gardien des Systèmes - ULTIME (avec Sysmon)

div.style: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f0f0f, #1a1a1a); padding: 25px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.2); border: 1px solid #00ff41; margin: 10px;

h1.style: text-align:center; color:#00FF41; margin:0; font-size:36px; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,65,0.5);

div.h2: Niveau de Menace : FAIBLE ⚠ BRUTE FORCE EN COURS ⚠

search.query: (index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main) (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational") | stats count by host | sort host

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ | stats count as base | appendpipe [search EventCode=4625 | stats count as failed] | appendpipe [search EventCode IN (1102,1104) | stats count as clear] | appendpipe [search EventCode IN (4726,4740) | stats count as dangerous_ad] | fillnull value=0 failed clear dangerous_ad | eval score = max(0, round(100 - (failed * 0.5 + clear * 20 + dangerous_ad * 10), 0)) | table score
index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" $host_token$ | stats count
index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode=4625 | stats count
index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode=4624 | stats count

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode IN (4720,4722,4724,4725,4726,4738,4740) | eval Action = case( EventCode=4720, "Création", EventCode=4722, "Activation", EventCode=4724, "Réinit. MDP", EventCode=4725, "Désactivation", EventCode=4726, "Suppression", EventCode=4738, "Modification", EventCode=4740, "Verrouillage" ) | stats count by Action | sort - count

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode IN (4720,4722,4724,4725,4726,4738,4740) | eval Action=case(EventCode=4720,"🟢 Création", EventCode=4726,"🔴 Suppression", EventCode=4738,"🟡 Modification", EventCode=4740,"🔴 Verrouillage", 1=1,"Autre") | table _time, host, Action, TargetUserName, SubjectUserName, IpAddress | rename host AS "DC", TargetUserName AS "Compte", SubjectUserName AS "Par" | sort -_time | head 30

panel.title: 🌐 Top 10 IP avec le plus d'échecs

search.query: index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode=4625 | fillnull value="-" IpAddress | search IpAddress!="-" IpAddress!="::1" IpAddress!="127.0.0.1" | stats count by IpAddress | sort -count | head 10
index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode=4625 | stats count by TargetUserName | sort -count | head 10

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode IN (4624,4625,4634,4647) | eval Type=case(EventCode=4624,"Réussie", EventCode=4625,"Échouée", 1=1,"Déconnexion") | timechart count by Type

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode=4625 | fillnull value="-" IpAddress, WorkstationName, LogonType | eval LogonTypeName=case(LogonType=10,"RDP", LogonType=2,"Console", LogonType=3,"Réseau", 1=1,"Autre") | table _time, host, TargetUserName, LogonTypeName, IpAddress, WorkstationName | sort -_time | head 25

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" $host_token$ EventCode=4624 | table _time, host, TargetUserName, IpAddress, WorkstationName | sort -_time | head 20

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" $host_token$ EventID=1 | stats count by Image, ParentImage | sort - count | head 15 | rename Image AS "Processus", ParentImage AS "Parent"

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" $host_token$ EventID=3 | fillnull value="-" DestinationIp | search DestinationIp!="-" DestinationIp!="127.0.0.1" DestinationIp!="::1" DestinationIp!="10.*" DestinationIp!="192.168.*" DestinationIp!="172.16.*" | stats count by DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Image | sort - count | head 10

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" $host_token$ EventID=10 | stats count by SourceImage, TargetImage | sort - count | head 10

index=* OR index=wineventlog OR index=windows OR index=main sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" $host_token$ EventID=11 | search TargetFilename=*.ps1 OR TargetFilename=*.vbs OR TargetFilename=*.bat OR TargetFilename=*.exe OR TargetFilename=*.dll OR TargetFilename=*\\Temp\\* OR TargetFilename=*\\AppData\\* OR TargetFilename=*\\Downloads\\* | table _time, host, Image, TargetFilename | sort - _time | head 20
